title: Professor Nichole: Prejac and Beta Brainwashing 101 (F4M)
description:
You’ve been struggling in Professor Nichole’s class, and now you’ve been summoned after office hours for a serious conversation about your future. You’re already intimated just at the thought of being in front of her heels, or seeing her red lips up close.
She’s been studying you. And she knows exactly the type of student you are. The kind that’s shy. The kind that stares. The kind that has no business even speaking to women without being spoken to.
And she has a very special opportunity for you to be a test subject for her prejac conversion program. Oh, and this doesn’t end in her office. She’s going to have fun with these triggers the next time you’re in class…
author: Goddess Nichole
